narration.full_text: Let's understand the reflex arc. Imagine you accidentally touch a hot object. This heat acts as a stimulus. This stimulus is detected by receptor organs, which in this case would be the skin on your hand. From the receptor organ, the signal travels to the spinal cord. The spinal cord processes this information and sends a signal to the effector organ, which are the muscles in your hand and arm. Finally, the effector organ responds, causing you to quickly withdraw your hand from the hot object. This entire rapid, involuntary action is known as a reflex.
